bundle.carried_note: atomic-debug/ is the per-segment view of each original: one <path> per atom, carrying data-atom (element.segment), data-src (the SVG element it came from) and data-kind (its segment class), each stroked on a hue ramp so the decomposition is visible. It is analyzer output, not the designer's own structure -- native circles come back as four quarter-arcs and colours run sequentially rather than by meaning -- so read it as a segment inventory, never as a part count to reproduce. The segmentCount and segmentKinds on every entry here are counted from it, and tests assert the two still agree. Restored to the bundle on 2026-09-07; it had been omitted since the 2026-09-03 import.
